name: La Ceiba

queries.query: La Ceiba Honduras official cadastral parcel map GIS cadastre registry
queries.result: Found the official La Ceiba municipal cadastral transparency page, the national SINAP property/geospatial system, the IGN cartography page, and the SINIT municipal module. The public material documents the municipal cadastre and national map services, but no verified public La Ceiba parcel-geometry API response was obtained.

queries.result: La búsqueda oficial encontró la página de Información Catastral de la Alcaldía Municipal de La Ceiba, SINIT 0101 La Ceiba, IGN, and SINAP. The municipal page lists cadastral reports and procedures, while SINIT lists thematic maps; neither exposed a bounded anonymous parcel-polygon response for this city.

registryEvidence.custodian: Alcaldía Municipal de La Ceiba, Departamento de Catastro; national cadastral/geospatial coordination is evidenced through the Instituto de la Propiedad / IGN / SINAP.

officialSources.observation: Official transparency page for Alcaldía Municipal de La Ceiba, Información Catastral. It lists cadastral reports through 2025/2026 updates and older entries for municipal lots, ejidal land, and property records.
officialSources.scope: Local municipal cadastre and published administrative information; no public parcel geometry was exposed in the fetched page.

officialSources.observation: Official SINIT module for 0101 La Ceiba with municipal thematic map downloads and a Solicitar Capa route; listed maps are protected areas, water resources, roads, settlements, soils, and similar thematic layers, not parcel polygons.
officialSources.scope: Municipal thematic geospatial information for La Ceiba.

officialSources.observation: Official IGN page states that cartographic services derive from Instituto de la Propiedad responsibilities and explicitly lists urban maps of La Ceiba among national cartographic products.
officialSources.scope: National cartography and cadastral coordination; not a verified parcel-feature service for this packet.

officialSources.observation: Search-discovered official SINAP ArcGIS municipal-boundary service; metadata indicated UTM zone 16N and municipal boundary scope, not parcel geometry. Direct bounded retrieval was blocked with HTTP 403/Cloudflare.
officialSources.scope: National municipal boundary service; not parcel coverage.
